description: Clean Air Markets Program Data (CAMPD) is the US Environmental Protection Agency's publication warehouse for allowance, compliance, emissions and facility and unit attribute data collected under the federal market-based trading programmes for power plants; it covers units reporting under those national programmes. The EPA API portal page, read on 2026-09-26, says the Industrial Power and Processing Division provides REST APIs, documented in Swagger, for emissions, account and compliance data, that developers request an API key, and that CAMPD emissions are apportioned for units with complex configurations, whereas raw reported data sit in the Emissions Collection and Monitoring Plan System (ECMPS 2.0), which also shows monitoring plans and quality assurance tests. A Power Sector Emissions Data Guide explains the difference. The CAMPD web application itself loads by script, so its download options were not read. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): Public domain (EPA web policy: EPA-produced data are in the public domain unless otherwise specified). Access is free of charge. Caveats: apportioned emissions differ from raw reports. Simulation uses are unit-level operating and emissions histories for generator dispatch calibration and capacity planning of fossil fleets. Related records: data-eia-923-power-plant-operations gives plant generation and fuel use.
